description: Department-led autonomous operating model for Controlled Live Action Gateway

stages.name: Owner Goal Intake
stages.description: Intake owner goals and map questions

stages.name: CEO Mission Interpretation
stages.description: CEO translates owner goal into department directives

stages.name: Department Briefing
stages.description: COO distributes brief to all 10 departments

stages.name: Cross-Department Negotiation
stages.description: Departments debate, refine, and finalize artifact list without fixed lists

stages.name: Worker Assignment
stages.description: COO maps expert agents/workers to each artifact

stages.name: Artifact Generation
stages.description: Execute creation of all negotiated deliverables

stages.name: QA Review
stages.description: QA department audits deliverables for safety wording and hard locks

stages.name: Gap Analysis
stages.description: Identify any omissions or security loop-holes

stages.name: Final Packaging
stages.description: CFO verifies counts and COO compiles final package index

stages.name: KPI Scoring
stages.description: CLO and CFO score execution against KPI criteria

stages.name: Premerge Simulation
stages.description: Simulate compatibility with all previous milestones
